f3_program: collection("mark.election_vote_totals_by_area", "vote_total", "election", source("votes in an area"))
member("mark.election_vote_totals_by_area", "mark.election_votes.area_with_100000_voters.count", source("votes in an area"))
member("mark.election_vote_totals_by_area", "mark.election_votes.remaining_area.count", source("total votes in the remaining area"))
observe(at("election.area_with_100000_voters.voters.count", "current"), 100000, "count", source("an area with 100,000 voters"))

percent_of(at("mark.election_votes.area_with_100000_voters.count", "current"), at("election.area_with_100000_voters.voters.count", "current"), 70, source("wins 70% of the votes in an area with 100,000 voters"))

multiple(at("mark.election_votes.remaining_area.count", "current"), at("mark.election_votes.area_with_100000_voters.count", "current"), 2, source("He got twice as many total votes in the remaining area"))
query("sum", "mark.election_vote_totals_by_area", "current")
assumptions: Each voter contributes one vote, and "twice as many" refers to Mark's votes in the first-mentioned area.

f3_program: observe(at("american_broadband.video_service_customers.net_additions_losses", "2019"), -4697, "count", source("Fiscal 2019 video service customers net losses stood at 4,697"))
observe(at("american_broadband.video_service_customers.net_additions_losses", "2018"), -6760, "count", cell("Video service customers", "August 31, 2018 (1)"))
query("difference", at("american_broadband.video_service_customers.net_additions_losses", "2018"), at("american_broadband.video_service_customers.net_additions_losses", "2019"))
collection("rangers_apprentice.books", "book", "rangers_apprentice_series", source("There are 14 books in the series"))
observe(at("rangers_apprentice.books.unread.count", "initial"), 14, "count", source("There are 14 books in the series"))
observe(at("rangers_apprentice.pages_per_book", "current"), 200, "page", source("each book has 200 pages"))
remove("read_first_month", "sabrina", at("rangers_apprentice.books.unread.count", "current"), 4, source("She read four books in a month"))

remove("read_second_month", "sabrina", at("rangers_apprentice.books.unread.count", "current"), fraction(at("rangers_apprentice.books.unread.count", "current"), 1, 2), source("half the number of books remaining in the second month"))

product_relation(at("sabrina.rangers_apprentice.pages_to_read.count", "current"), at("rangers_apprentice.pages_per_book", "current"), at("rangers_apprentice.books.unread.count", "current"), source("each book has 200 pages"))
query("value", at("sabrina.rangers_apprentice.pages_to_read.count", "current"))
assumptions: The 14-book series initializes Sabrina's unread set when the narrative begins.

f3_program: collection("war.first_side.soldiers", "soldier", "war.first_side", source("first side has 4000 soldiers"))
observe(at("war.first_side.soldiers.count", "current"), 4000, "count", source("first side has 4000 soldiers"))
collection("war.second_side.soldiers", "soldier", "war.second_side", source("the other side 500 soldiers fewer than the first side"))
offset(at("war.second_side.soldiers.count", "current"), at("war.first_side.soldiers.count", "current"), -500, "count", source("the other side 500 soldiers fewer than the first side"))
observe(at("war.first_side.food_per_soldier", "every_day"), 10, "pound", source("each needs 10 pounds of food every day"))

offset(at("war.second_side.food_per_soldier", "every_day"), at("war.first_side.food_per_soldier", "every_day"), -2, "pound", source("soldiers in the second are each given 2 pounds less food than the first side"))

product_relation(at("war.first_side.food_total", "every_day"), at("war.first_side.food_per_soldier", "every_day"), at("war.first_side.soldiers.count", "current"), source("soldiers on opposite sides of a war each needs 10 pounds of food every day"))

product_relation(at("war.second_side.food_total", "every_day"), at("war.second_side.food_per_soldier", "every_day"), at("war.second_side.soldiers.count", "current"), source("soldiers in the second are each given 2 pounds less food than the first side"))
collection("war.food_eaten_by_side", "side_food_total", "war", source("food both sides are eating altogether every day"))
member("war.food_eaten_by_side", "war.first_side.food_total", source("food both sides are eating altogether every day"))
member("war.food_eaten_by_side", "war.second_side.food_total", source("food both sides are eating altogether every day"))
query("sum", "war.food_eaten_by_side", "every_day")
assumptions: The stated 10-pound daily need is the first side's per-soldier ration and therefore the reference for the second side's reduction.
